amendments.text: drop tests. If compliance with the reserve energy absorption condition specified in § 3.352 (b) is demonstrated by free drop tests, the drop height shall be not less than 1.44 times the drop height specified in § 3.353. In simulating wing lift equal to the airplane weight, the units shall be dropped with an effective mass equal to where the symbols and other details are the same as in § 3.353. RETRACTING MECHANISM
